scope: twenty-minute five-chapter expedition; zero versus recorded moderate camp growth; not player win-rate estimation
methodNotes: Engine simulations and browser realtime sessions are separate evidence.
All engine cases use starter tracer, 60 Hz, 1000x620, normal helpers, normal in-run choices. Chapter/default reward callbacks choose the first offered valid reward.
Changing offers and event eligibility changes RNG consumption; same seed does not mean identical enemy layout across revisions.
Browser fixtures copy legal camp profiles to per-tab memory before loading the engine. No invulnerability, speedup, time jumps or forced in-run equipment.
Browser viewport 1280x900; CSS canvas about 1203x720 at DPR 1.5. These samples are not directly matched to engine geometry.
Intermediate snapshots and deaths are retained separately; no unfinished session counts as victory.
